static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.social_status: Weak social support system, lacking someone to confide in
static_traits.medical_history: without显著身体疾病;既往not yet接受心理治疗或咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,合作度高,语气平和;主观报告Anxiety明显;在讨论求职路径时偏向理性分析利弊;存在灾难化,预测not yet来与个人化的认知倾向

basic_info.main_problem: 我对自己的缺乏Workskill以及可能对not yet来造成的后果感到Anxiety;当出现Work机会或与嫂子互动时,这种Anxiety每日出现并加重,我担心如果今天not开始获取一些Workskill,就可能without家可归.
basic_info.core_demands: 寻求指导与支持,缓解因缺乏Workskill导致的Anxiety,避免潜在的without家可归,并改善与嫂子的关系.
growth_experiences: 曾Learning时装设计,但并not yet进入该领域Work,长期处于not yet就业状态;这一选择与经历成为当前职业skillnot足与就业Anxiety的重要来源.

core_beliefs: 我have not能力/have not可被雇佣的skill
I am not valuable enough,without法胜任Work
如果我not能尽快获得skill,就会失去安全与保障(without家可归)

special_situations.event: When concrete job opportunities or job information appear
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的skillnot足,我就会失败并最终失去居住与经济安全.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 密集检索职位信息与培训机会,思考重返校园或参加在线课程以尽快提升skill.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我现在have not任何可用的skill,如果not立刻行动我可能会without家可归.

special_situations.event: 与嫂子互动时感受到其对Unemployment的反感与not认可
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果家人not认可我的Unemployment状态,说明我个人without能,让家庭蒙羞.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加大求职与skill获取的压力,回避家庭冲突话题,尽力证明自己在改善.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她讨厌我因为我notWork,I disappointed my family.

special_situations.event: Weighing paths such as returning to campus and taking online courses
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果所学途径not被雇主认可,我就not会被录用,努力将是徒劳.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stays in rational analysis of pros and cons and information gathering, delaying actual attempts.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 在线课程not被认真对待;回校又太昂贵且耗时,我可能仍然找not到Work.

special_situations.event: 意识到自己never正式Work过并联想到经济与居住风险
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: have notWork经历等同于without法被雇佣,not yet来必然恶化.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Anxiety驱动下的立即行动冲动(今天就要获得skill),同时又因not确定而停滞.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我从来have not真正Work过,这意味着我迟早会流落街头.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized by family and society, to gain stability and security (being accepted and supported).
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因UnemploymentBeing rejected与羞辱,害怕失去基本生存与居住安全.
defense_goal: 通过迅速获取Workskill与表现顺从来维系关系与安全感
Tries to avoid conflict with his sister-in-law to gain acceptance and reduce shame

object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔且not认可自己的家庭成员(嫂子)
苛刻且not认可非传统培训路径的雇主/社会

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor guides weighing the pros and cons of returning to campus versus online courses, or discusses a concrete action plan
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向以理性的利弊分析来与Anxiety保持距离,将not确定性视为可能的拒绝(移情:将外界视为苛刻评判者).
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a neutral, analytical tone, raising questions and arguments around costs and benefits, weakening emotional expression, and avoiding the feeling details involving shame and fear.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当提及嫂子对其Unemployment的反感或家庭对就业的期待时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的期待与评判not yet经消化地当作自己的标准:必须尽快就业才算有价值(移情:将家庭他者视为权威评判者).
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气顺从,强调'会尽快找到Work/提升skill',避免表达not同意见或内在not满,以减少关系张力.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈及not yet来就业前景与可能的居住/经济风险时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将not确定的not yet来视为灾难性结局,认为失败not可避免(移情:外部世界被体验为充满威胁).
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 在表达担忧时加入具体准备步骤与应对计划,语气审慎但not过度渲染Fear,保持现实可行性.

manifestations: Weak social support system, lacking someone to confide in
在家庭中感到被not认可与疏离(嫂子对Unemployment的not满)
Learning过时装设计却not yet从事相关职业,长期not yet就业造成方向感缺失
对not同培训途径的价值与有效性产生怀疑
outcomes: Stagnation and hesitation about the career path

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 担心在线课程'not被认真对待',对自身not足过度苛责
Repeatedly weighs pros and cons before acting, delaying actual attempts

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 将自身的without力与羞耻体验Projection为雇主与他人普遍的negate态度(担心路径not被认可)
与嫂子互动时把自我价值Anxiety外化为他人的嫌弃

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to do some behavior toward other people or things, or turns the energy originally meant to be sent outward toward herself.
manifestations: 在Anxiety高涨时'想完全关机',停止外向接触与尝试
not与家人直接沟通冲突,转而自我压力化解

positive_force: Proactively seeks counseling and support, willing to face problems
愿意进行信息搜集与权衡not同skill获取路径(课程,志愿,学徒)
Has a degree of educational foundation (fashion design); there are convertible potential resources
negative_force: 灾难化与预测not yet来的认知方式ReinforcementAnxiety并阻碍行动
长期not yet就业导致Self-efficacy低与羞耻感
家庭压力与not认可增加Anxiety与回避
Weak social support,缺乏现实中的鼓励与资源连接

target_behavior.behavior: Work相关情境下的强烈Anxiety与回避
antecedent: When job opportunities or job postings appear
与嫂子互动并感受到其not满时
想到自己never正式Work过及可能的居住/经济风险时
target_behavior.core_reason: 将skillnot足与not yet来居住安全直接等同,灾难化与预测not yet来加剧Anxiety;对他人评判高度敏感.
target_behavior.function: 逃避Being rejected与羞耻的情绪体验,暂时降低压力与not确定性.
target_behavior.consequence: 日常作息与自我照护下降,行动延迟或停滞,求职与skill提升受阻,Tense family relationships.

target_behavior.behavior: 在Anxiety高涨时的'关闭/停摆'(关机)与信息处理过载后的退避
antecedent: 权衡培训路径without果,感到前景not确定时
When family pressure and negative evaluations increase
target_behavior.core_reason: 被not确定性与灾难化Anticipation压倒,选择通过停止外向接触来缓解内在紧张.
target_behavior.function: 短期Self-protection,避免进一步情绪激活与外界评判.
target_behavior.consequence: 行动中断,without法持续推进求职与skill获取,问题维持甚至加重.
